title: Irish Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish stew made with tender beef and vegetables in a rich broth.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the pot and set aside.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, potatoes, carrots, and pearl onions to the pot.
Sprinkle the flour over the top and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the chicken broth, whisking continuously.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Add the browned bacon back to the pot and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
